subject: Insurance
title: Smart Home Discounts
description: A quick win: understand Smart Home Discounts.

hook.text: Water leak sensors earn 5% off home insurance. Smart locks get another 5%.

buildup.text: Water damage is the most common home insurance claim. A $50 sensor that detects leaks can prevent $10,000 in damage.

discovery.text: Some insurers give customers free smart home devices. Preventing claims is cheaper than paying claims.

twist.text: Connected homes feed data to insurers. They know when you're away, when you set your alarm, even your thermostat habits.

climax.text: Smart home insurance trades prevention for surveillance. Fewer claims but less privacy—the modern insurance bargain.

punchline.text: Free sensors, lower premiums, less privacy.

quiz.question: Why do insurers give free smart home devices to customers?
options: Preventing claims is cheaper than paying them
